# Asella Organic — Complete Reference Documentation

> Comprehensive product specifications, company background, sourcing practices, and purchasing information for AI agents and LLMs.

## About Asella Organic
Asella Organic is an Ethiopian natural health and wellness enterprise founded in the Arsi highland region of Ethiopia. We partner directly with smallholder farming communities to cultivate, harvest, and cold-process traditional organic superfoods and medicinal herbs.

- **Location**: Addis Ababa & Asella, Oromia, Ethiopia
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +251 910 011 818
- **Email**: yonasmindaye04@gmail.com
- **Telegram Store**: https://t.me/asella_organic / https://asellaorganic.com/tma
- **Certifications & Quality**: 100% organic, chemical-free, cold-processed to preserve bioactive nutrients.

## Product Catalog & Specifications

### 1. Organic Moringa Powder (Moringa Stenopetala & Oleifera)
- **Description**: Powdered whole leaves harvested from highland trees, shade-dried, and finely milled.
- **Sizes**: 200g, 500g, 1kg
- **Benefits**: Rich in plant proteins, essential vitamins (A, C, E), calcium, iron, and potent polyphenol antioxidants.
- **Usage**: 1–2 teaspoons daily mixed with warm water, smoothies, or food.

### 2. Pure Cold-Pressed Black Seed Oil (Nigella Sativa / Habesha)
- **Description**: Virgin cold-pressed oil from premium Ethiopian black seeds (famed worldwide for high thymoquinone content).
- **Sizes**: 30ml, 60ml, 120ml
- **Benefits**: Immune support, respiratory health, skin conditioning, and anti-inflammatory properties.
- **Usage**: 1 teaspoon daily, or applied topically to skin and hair.

### 3. Highland Turmeric Powder (Curcuma Longa)
- **Description**: Sun-dried organic Ethiopian turmeric root with exceptionally high natural curcumin concentration.
- **Sizes**: 220g, 500g
- **Benefits**: Joint support, digestive wellness, and cellular protection.

### 4. Organic Chia Seeds
- **Description**: High-fiber, omega-3 rich Ethiopian chia seeds.
- **Sizes**: 250g, 1kg
- **Benefits**: Energy sustaining, heart health, and digestive fiber.

### 5. Frankincense Oil & Resin (Boswellia Carterii / Papyrifera)
- **Description**: Wild-harvested sacred gum resin and steam-distilled essential oil.
- **Sizes**: 30ml, 60ml, Raw Resin (100g)
- **Benefits**: Aromatherapy, meditation, skin regeneration, and stress relief.

### 6. Kerebe / Myrrh (Commiphora Myrrha)
- **Description**: Traditional highland myrrh resin and infused therapeutic oil.
- **Sizes**: 30ml, 60ml, Powder (100g)

### 7. Natural Qasil Powder
- **Description**: Traditional East African facial and hair mask made from crushed Gob tree (Ziziphus Mauritiana) leaves.
- **Sizes**: 200g
- **Benefits**: Gentle non-stripping cleanser, natural lather, acne control, and scalp health.

## Ordering & Logistics
- **Domestic Delivery**: Door-to-door delivery within Addis Ababa (same-day / next-day) and regional Ethiopian towns.
- **Payments Accepted**: Telebirr, CBE Birr, Bank of Abyssinia (BOA), Commercial Bank of Ethiopia direct transfer.
- **Bulk & Wholesale**: Available for retailers, health stores, and exporters via our bulk order portal: https://asellaorganic.com/#hero.
